_doc: Claude plugin directory edition: no scripts, only file types an unverified publisher may ship. build_release.py --claude-directory OUT applies this. Overlays replace a file and pin the source's SHA-256; replacements must each match exactly once. Both fail the build on drift.

plugin.description: Makes clear, honest charts that state their point, and critiques charts you share. Reviews the rendered chart against a checklist when Claude can view images. Scripted checks are in the full version on GitHub.

- `ev.titles()` wraps the title and subtitle to 2 lines at a phrase boundary and warns when any text block needs more; force a break with `\n`; `ev.save()` refits the layout.
- Layout fit covers grid subplots only. Colorbars: prefer `ax.inset_axes` or a direct-labeled legend strip.
